title: Otto Skorzeny in the same building as Ruark and Sicre

tellings.quote: Who lives in the same building as Roark and Sicre? Otto Skorzeny.

plain: A researcher who goes by JASON, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to a detail from Spain in the years after the Second World War. He says that two men, the writer Robert Ruark and Ricardo Sicre, lived in the same building as Otto Skorzeny, a German officer from the war. JASON raises it to suggest these men were connected in a hidden network.
